name: A Little Payback
summary: Sergeant Ulka asks you to strike back at the Naga inside Alcaz Prison. Kor'kron fighters were lost as they fell back, and Ulka wants the Naga to pay.

sections.title: Ulka's Demand
sections.body: The Kor'kron were falling back when another wave of Naga approached Alcaz Prison. Sergeant Ulka believes the fighting continues within. You are to kill the Naga you encounter, including the sorceress Ulka suspects leads them. The Kor'kron lost many orcs, and Ulka wants them answered in kind.

faq.answer: Sergeant Ulka, a Kor'kron, asks you to kill Naga inside Alcaz Prison.

faq.q: Why does Ulka want the Naga killed?
faq.answer: The Kor'kron lost many orcs while falling back from a second wave of Naga, and Ulka wants them to answer in kind.
Sergeant Ulka suspects the battle is still raging inside Alcaz Prison.

faq.q: Who does Ulka think leads the Naga?
faq.answer: Ulka saw a sorceress among the Naga and suspects she is their leader.

faq.q: What does Ulka ask me to bring back?
faq.answer: Ulka asks you to bring back the head of Tidemistress Ca'zass.

attribution: In-game quest text: A Little Payback
